description: Use when an agent needs the material events US companies disclosed in the last hours. Returns the 8-K filings filed across the market in the window, with company, CIK, filing time, accession number, the 8-K item codes and titles (e.g. 2.02 results, 5.02 officer changes, 1.01 agreements) and a count per item. Source: SEC EDGAR current filings. Costs 0.01 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
name: get_sec_8k
